news.headline: Delcath raises 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M amid plans for 37 active centers by year-end
news.source: Seeking Alpha / Delcath Systems Q2 2026 earnings release
news.summary: Delcath reported Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1 million (up ~20% YoY), with HEPZATO KIT sales up 21% to $27.1 million and gross margin at 90%; the company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M and now plans 37 active treatment centers by year-end. Shares jumped sharply on the report as investors focused on the beat and raised outlook.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management announced it will attend the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston on August 11, 2026, as part of ongoing investor outreach.

news.headline: Delcath Systems, Inc. Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath disclosed inducement restricted stock unit grants totaling 17,000 shares to new employees under its 2023 Inducement Plan, granted July 1, 2026 and vesting over three years, in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in Delcath's global randomized Phase 2 DELUMA trial (NCT06875128), which will enroll roughly 90 patients with liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer across more than 20 US and European sites, testing HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone.

pulse: Delcath's HEPZATO KIT commercial launch is accelerating, with Q2 2026 revenue up ~20% YoY, 90% gross margins, and raised full-year guidance to $104M-$108M alongside plans to reach 37 active treatment centers by year-end, sending shares toward 52-week highs. Beyond its approved uveal melanoma indication, the company is pushing pipeline expansion into liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (Phase 2 DELUMA trial, first patient dosed July 2026) and colorectal cancer. Near-term catalysts are incremental (conference appearances, center activations, trial enrollment) rather than binary regulatory events, with the next major checkpoint being the Q3 2026 earnings report.
